title: Same-image, common-metric BTD2 hero-card box comparison

target_reference.method: Manual pixel annotations on the exact source image, drawn tightly around the 16 yellow/orange selectable-card frames.
target_reference.scope: UI card frames only; excludes hero artwork outside frames, the selected second-card white halo, page arrow and Heroes label.

evaluation_contract.common_output: one pixel-space box or miss per each of the same 16 target card frames; hero-name correctness is not scored.
evaluation_contract.matching: Optimal one-to-one assignment maximizing total IoU, using a rectangular Hungarian algorithm; dummy columns represent misses.
evaluation_contract.mean_iou: mean assigned per-target IoU over all 16 targets; misses contribute zero.
evaluation_contract.proposal_scope_filter: All scores use candidate boxes whose centers are inside the card-strip ROI; unrelated UI regions outside it are excluded from precision, recall, and mean IoU.

roi.rule: keep proposal when its center is inside this half-open card-strip ROI

jev-box.name: Jev 1.14 Box
jev-box.evaluation_filter: none; caller returned only hero-card targets
jev-box.latency_scope: One prior TypeSafe request; recorded elapsed includes the HTTP call, but request-construction boundary is not fully documented.

caveats: Jev Box is one recorded call, not a repeatability estimate.
Local methods and YOLO each have five timed warm calls; result boxes are from the final call.
Local and remote timing scopes differ; latency is descriptive, not a controlled end-to-end speed ranking.
Historical comparisons remain in benchmark.json and are not mixed into this exact-image score table.
Reference boxes mark visible card frames; they do not identify hitboxes, enabled state or clickability.
No game input or additional external model request was made for this same-image comparison.
